item.title: Biochar for sustainable crop production
item.content:encoded:
Nature Reviews Earth & Environment, Published online: 03 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s43017-026-00847-2

Improving crop production is essential to meet the rising food demand of the increasing global population. This Review synthesizes global evidence that biochar enhances crop productivity, explores the underlying mechanisms and considers how biochar can contribute to sustainable food production.
